**答案：** 是 **South Orange Little League**，在佛罗里达州奥兰多（Orlando）西南部。Damon 6 岁时，母亲给他和哥哥 James 报名参加了这个联盟。他在这里的第一支球队是一支 T-ball 队，叫 "Green Machine"。之后他上了 Dr. Phillips High School。

**依据（只搜了 1 次）：**
- https://www.mlive.com/tigers/2010/04/now_with_tigers_veteran_big_le.html ：Damon 自己说："My mom signed me and my older brother, James, up for the South Orange Little League in southwest Orlando."
- https://ocps.ss15.sharpschool.com/cms/One.aspx?portalId=54703&pageId=89584 ："fulfilled his passion while playing in the South Orange Little League. By seventh grade…"
- https://www.orlandosentinel.com/2015/03/14/mlb-all-star-johnny-damon-helps-little-league-after-alleged-theft/ ：2015 年他回 South Orange Little League 帮忙筹款，还带来了自己 1982 年在少棒联盟拿的奖杯。
